audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4 and 6 are inverted relative to the packet chart and to the page's own prose. Disk gives Ryze level 6 while whys[4] says Blade of the Exile kills him there and Realm Warp answers nothing; disk gives Riven 2+ items while whys[6], spikes[3] and the late paragraph all say Seraph's is where Ryze takes over.
audit.why: 43.72% over 231 games — Riven owns the lane from level 2 to first item and level 6 is her strongest window, but two items is Ryze's. The mirror already flipped exactly these two rows in both of its layers as one atomic group.
audit.corrected: Ryze / Riven / Riven / Riven / Riven / Riven / Ryze, with row 4 and row 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs and ratings inverted.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 1 (her kit is not online), Lvl 3 (Q chain plus Ki Burst plus Valor), Eclipse spike, 2+ items. Blade of the Exile at 120/90/60s is correctly placed in whys[4] as her level-6 jump.
audit.corrected: Spike timings untouched; phases[4].why rewritten to match its corrected side.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] calls Wind Slash an execute. Riot's text describes Blade of the Exile as granting bonus Attack Damage and Range plus one use of Wind Slash, 'a powerful ranged attack' — no execute is stated, and the kit carries no execute flag. dosFull[2].d also invents a fifteen-second Ki Burst cooldown, and tldr/report[0].t call Riven 'his'.
audit.why: Real numbers: Ki Burst (W) is 11/10/9/8/7s at 260 range; Valor (E) is 10/9/8/7/6s and both dashes and blocks damage; Broken Wings (Q) is 13s with three casts and a knockback on the third; Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60s. Mirror-confirmed on Ryze's side: Rune Prison roots only once Spell Flux is applied, and it is 11s at rank 1 — that dependency is what makes 'bait E, then root' the correct order.
audit.corrected: Wind Slash is a one-shot ranged blow with extra range and AD, not a stated execute. Ki Burst is 7-11s and Valor 6-10s; step up only when both are down.
